name: guideframe-grid
title: GuideframeGrid
description: Design-tool layout grids, rulers and draggable, snapping guides drawn over the live page or one container, with a keyboard-reachable control panel and a geometry inspector.
label: GuideFrame
author: Dinil Thilakarathne <https://github.com/Dinil-Thilakarathne>
attribution: Copyright (c) 2026 GuideFrame. MIT License; the full notice ships inside each item.

props.name: enabled
props.description: Override the production gate. Unset (default), the overlay mounts in development and not when NODE_ENV is "production", as upstream. `true` always mounts it (for example a demo on a production build), `false` never does. Changing it remounts the overlay.

props.name: forceVisibleInProduction
props.description: Upstream's option: mount in production too. `enabled` takes precedence when set.

props.name: container
props.description: Scope the overlay to a positioned element instead of the page. Guides are stored relative to it, and the inspector, click pausing and Shift-drag selection stay inside it. Changing it remounts the overlay.

props.name: rulers
props.description: Top and left rulers; drag from one to place a guide, drop a guide back on it to delete.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column count, fixed or per breakpoint.

props.name: gutter
props.description: Gap between columns in CSS pixels.

props.name: margin
props.description: Outer margin of the grid in CSS pixels.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Maximum grid width, centred; a number, a pixel string or a percentage.

props.name: breakpoints
props.description: Minimum widths of the tablet and desktop breakpoints, matched against the viewport (or the container when scoped).

props.name: activeBreakpoint
props.description: Force one breakpoint.

props.name: color
props.description: Column, column-tick and accent color. Without it the token is used; its default is rgb(255 0 84).

props.name: opacity
props.description: Column opacity.

props.name: visible / defaultVisible / onVisibleChange
props.description: Controlled or uncontrolled grid visibility. Uncontrolled visibility persists under `storageKey`.

props.name: guides / defaultGuides / onGuidesChange
props.description: Controlled or initial guides (`{ id, axis: "x" | "y", position, locked? }`). Uncontrolled guides persist per route under `guidesStorageKey`.

props.name: snap
props.description: Snap guides to element edges, column boundaries and other guides within `threshold` pixels (6). Hold Cmd/Ctrl while dragging to place freely.

props.name: panel
props.description: Allow the floating control panel.

props.name: defaultPanelOpen
props.description: Open the panel on first load; a stored open or closed choice wins.

props.name: onPanelOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Global shortcuts (Cmd/Ctrl+G, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G, Shift+R, Shift+L, Shift+M, Shift+Z). When false the panel hides its shortcut hints; guide deletion, nudging and Escape still work on a selection.

props.name: storageKey / guidesStorageKey / panelStorageKey
props.description: localStorage keys. The panel's position is stored under `${panelStorageKey}-position`. Give each scoped instance its own keys.

props.name: zIndex
props.description: Stacking order of the overlay root.

props.name: position
props.description: Page overlay positioning; `container` implies absolute.

props.name: useGuideframe(options)
props.type: { visible, guides, panelOpen, setVisible, setGuides, clearGuides, setPanelOpen }
props.description: The same overlay driven from your own UI. Takes the options above and returns live state and setters.

a11y: The control panel is a labelled non-modal dialog. Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+G moves focus to it so the next Tab reaches its controls; Escape inside it, or the labelled close button, closes it and returns focus to where it was.

Every panel toggle is a native button with role switch and aria-checked. Shortcut hints are hidden from assistive technology and exposed as aria-keyshortcuts instead, only while shortcuts are enabled.
The Clear guides actions are a disclosure (aria-expanded and aria-controls on the trigger) over a labelled group of ordinary buttons; Escape collapses it and returns focus to the trigger.
The grid, rulers, guides and drag readout are aria-hidden: they are a visual instrument. Selection counts and inspector messages are announced through role status.

Placing a guide is pointer-only, as upstream: drag from a ruler. Selected guides move with the arrow keys (Shift for 10px) and delete with Backspace or Delete; `defaultGuides`, `guides` and `setGuides` place guides without a pointer.
Focus is visible as a two-pixel outline in the accent color. Panel text and hints meet 4.5:1 on the panel surface.
The column reveal and the switch and chevron transitions are removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

Right-to-left: the panel mirrors (it opens on the left, its content uses logical properties, and the switch thumb and chevron follow the direction). The rulers, grid, guides and readouts stay left-to-right because they measure physical CSS pixels, so the vertical ruler stays on the left.
